	We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Engineerto oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and performance of our manufacturing plant.

	The ideal candidate is an Electrical / Electronics Engineer with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in plant operations and maintenance.
	The candidate must possess valid COREN and NEMSA certifications and demonstrate strong leadership, technical, and problem-solving abilities.

	Manage the day-to-day operations of the manufacturing plant to ensure maximum productivity and efficiency.

	Collaborate with Production, Quality Assurance, Procurement, and Engineering teams to achieve operational objectives.
	Manage inventory levels for spare parts, tools, and maintenance materials.
	Investigate equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
	Ensure all plant assets are properly maintained and utilized effectively.


Job Requirements
Applicants must possess:


	A Bachelor&#39;s Degree (B.Eng. or B.Sc.) in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
	A minimum of 5 years of experience in plant management, plant maintenance, or manufacturing operations.
	Valid COREN Registration (Compulsory).
	Valid NEMSA Certification/Licence (Compulsory).
	Proven experience managing electrical systems, industrial equipment, and plant maintenance.
	Strong understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance practices.
	Knowledge of occupational health and safety regulations.
	Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.

	Plant Operations Management
	Preventive &amp; Corrective Maintenance
	Electrical Systems Management
	Industrial Equipment Maintenance
	Leadership &amp; Team Management
	Production Planning
	Root Cause Analysis
	Troubleshooting &amp; Fault Diagnosis
	Budget Management
	Project Management
	Quality Management Systems
	Health, Safety &amp; Environmental (HSE) Compliance
	Risk Assessment &amp; Mitigation
	Inventory &amp; Asset Management
	Process Improvement
	Excellent Communication &amp; Report Writing
	Decision-Making &amp; Problem-Solving
	Time Management
	Microsoft Office Suite
	Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS experience is an advantage).


Educational Qualification


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
	COREN Registration (Mandatory).
	NEMSA Certification/Licence (Mandatory).
	Additional certifications in Project Management, HSE, Maintenance Management, Lean Manufacturing, or Six Sigma will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 5 years&#39; experience managing plant operations or industrial maintenance in a manufacturing environment.
	Demonstrated experience supervising technical teams and ensuring operational excellence.
	Experience in electrical installations, industrial automation, or manufacturing systems is highly desirable.


Personal Attributes:


	High level of integrity and professionalism.
	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Excellent analytical and decision-making ability.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Proactive and results-driven.
	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
	Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.


Method of Application&nbsp;

	Practise defensive driving and exercise sound judgement in challenging road and traffic conditions.
	Ensure the vehicle is properly secured when parked and follow appropriate security procedures.
	Be available to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, or outside normal working hours when required by the nature of the role.
	Perform other driving and related duties as may be assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Minimum of 3 years of proven experience as an Official, Corporate, Executive, or Personal Driver.
	Valid Nigerian Driver&rsquo;s Licence.
	Excellent knowledge of Abuja roads and major routes.
	Demonstrable knowledge of defensive and safe driving practices.
	Good understanding of basic vehicle maintenance and ability to identify common vehicle faults.
	Clean driving record and a strong commitment to road safety.
	Previous experience driving for Senior Management, Executives, or corporate organisations will be an added advantage.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Must be punctual, disciplined, trustworthy, respectful, and responsible.
	Must demonstrate a high level of confidentiality, discretion, and integrity.
	Must be security-conscious and able to exercise good judgement while transporting passengers.
	Must be well-presented and maintain a professional appearance.
	Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
	Willingness to work flexible hours when required.
	Must be physically fit and capable of carrying out the responsibilities of the role.


We Are Looking For Someone Who is:


	Reliable and punctual
	Safety-conscious
	Trustworthy and discreet
	Security-conscious
	Professional and well-mannered
	Knowledgeable about Abuja roads
	Careful with vehicles
	Flexible and dependable
	Calm under pressure
	Committed to excellent service


Method of Applictaion&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: recruitment@bluebrainservices.com using &quot;Application &ndash; Official Driver&quot; as the subject of the email.

	Must demonstrate a high level of confidentiality, discretion, and integrity.
	Must be security-conscious and able to exercise good judgement while transporting passengers.
	Must be well-presented and maintain a professional appearance.
	Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
	Willingness to work flexible hours when required.
	Must be physically fit and capable of carrying out the responsibilities of the role.


We Are Looking For Someone Who is:


	Reliable and punctual
	Safety-conscious
	Trustworthy and discreet
	Security-conscious
	Professional and well-mannered
	Knowledgeable about Abuja roads
	Careful with vehicles
	Flexible and dependable
	Calm under pressure
	Committed to excellent service


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Application – Official Driver" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Position: Technical Sales (Engineer) Executive - FNL (Architectural Glass & Partition Systems)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Description


	We are looking for candidates with sales ability, but also measurement accuracy, architectural drawing interpretation, glass knowledge, quotation preparation, client management and project coordination.


Key Responsibilities
